title: Conveyor Belt Scanning Anomaly
description:
At a fulfillment center, an automated scanner processes a line of parcels moving along a conveyor belt. The scanner logs the integer tracking code of each parcel into an array `tracking_ids` in the exact sequence they pass the sensor.

Due to physical belt vibrations, a single parcel may occasionally be scanned more than once. Your task is to analyze the log for a single shipment batch and determine if any parcel tracking code appears at least twice in the sequence.

Return `true` if at least one tracking code occurs multiple times in the array, or `false` if every scanned parcel code is unique.
input_format: An array of integers `tracking_ids` representing the sequence of scanned parcel codes.
output_format: Return `true` if any tracking code appears at least twice in the array; otherwise, return `false`.

examples.explanation: The tracking code 102 appears twice in the scan log (at index 0 and index 3).
All parcel tracking codes in the log are distinct.
The scan log contains only a single parcel code, so no duplicates exist.
